zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 V1.3（载体版）是用于构建新鲜冷冻样本的组织切片全转录本 3' 端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子并进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过 DNBSEQ 测序和 STOmics 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit V1.3 (Chip) is a reagent kit used for constructing whole transcriptome 3' end libraries from tissue sections of fresh frozen samples. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology featuring high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information, which, upon binding to tissue sections, capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ for cDNA synthesis. Researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomics information for specific samples at ultra-high resolution using DNBSEQ sequencing and the accompanying STOmics visualization analysis tools.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this reagent kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation to ensure the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent.

zh: 行修理，直至肉眼可以观察到植物组织，再调成10 µm 的厚度对植物组织进行修理，直至组织的目标区域出现。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm，将植物组织的目标区域切成10 µm 厚的切片，用预冷的毛刷将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，如果四周的OCT 翘起，则可以用毛刷将切片轻轻翻转，慢慢平铺在切片台上（切片详细步骤请参考3.2 切片准备）；用干净的粘附载玻片进行贴片，拿起玻片的一端，将玻片正面朝下，对准切片，轻轻按压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到玻片表面（该贴片方式为热贴），切两片相邻切片分别贴在2 张玻片上，命名为玻片①和玻片②；
en: until the plant tissue is visible to the naked eye, then adjust to a thickness of 10 µm to trim the plant tissue until the target area appears. Select the section thickness according to requirements, usually 10 µm, and cut the target area of the plant tissue into 10 µm thick sections. Use a pre-cooled brush to move the section to the right edge of the sectioning stage, then gently nudge the surrounding OCT with the brush to flatten the section. If the surrounding OCT curls up, you can gently flip the section with the brush and slowly lay it flat on the stage (please refer to 3.2 Sectioning Preparation for detailed steps). Mount the section using a clean adhesive slide; pick up one end of the slide, place the front side of the slide face down, align it with the section, and press gently. The section should be visibly adhered to the surface of the slide (this mounting method is heat mounting). Cut two adjacent sections and mount them on 2 separate slides, labeled as Slide ① and Slide ②;

en: 1) Cover the tissue on each of the two slides with 200 μL of Nuclease-Free Water, let stand for 1 min, then gently discard the water and observe whether there is any tissue detachment;

zh: 1) 用无尘纸擦去组织周围多余液体，用气瓶将组织小心吹干，将玻片平放在实验台，将盖玻片放入装有100% 乙醇的培养皿中，清洗后吹干备用（用气瓶或风扇），此步骤为了减少后续拍照时由盖玻片带入的杂质；
en: 1) Wipe excess liquid around the tissue with lint-free paper, and carefully dry the tissue with an air duster. Place the slide flat on the workbench. Immerse the coverslip in a petri dish filled with 100% ethanol, then rinse, dry, and set aside for use (using an air duster or fan); this step is to minimize impurities introduced by the coverslip during subsequent imaging;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 取其中一张玻片①，滴加5 μL H&E Mounting Medium 到组织中间（组织面积小于0.5 cm*0.5 cm 可滴加1.5 μL），用清洗晾干后的盖玻片封片（注意不要带入气泡），准备拍照；
en: 2) Take one slide ①, add 5 μL of H&E Mounting Medium to the center of the tissue (if the tissue area is less than 0.5 cm x 0.5 cm, 1.5 μL may be added), mount with the cleaned and dried coverslip (ensuring no air bubbles are introduced), and prepare for imaging;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 4)  在载物台上滴1-2 μL 水，将载玻片置于水滴上方起到固定作用。打开显微镜，在显微镜控制软件上新建文件夹，注明相关信息，选择透射光，在DAPI通道下拍照，观察玻片①中的组织是否有自发荧光，并与玻片②中的FB 染色法组织成像作对比（拍照步骤参考3.6，注意只需要在DAPI 通道拍照即可）；
en: 4) Pipette 1-2 μL of water onto the stage and place the glass slide over the water droplet to secure it. Turn on the microscope, create a new folder in the microscope control software, label it with relevant information, select transmitted light, and capture images under the DAPI channel. Observe whether the tissue on slide ① exhibits autofluorescence, and compare it with the imaging of the tissue stained with the FB staining method on slide ② (refer to 3.6 for imaging steps; note that imaging only under the DAPI channel is required);
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 可分别用10X 和20X 物镜观察组织和细胞形态，如10X 物镜下组织细胞形态满足后续分析需求，则在正式实验中可选择用10X 物镜拍摄（可在拍照环节节省时间），图像无需转换即可QC；若对图像分辨率要求较高，则在正式实验中可选择用20X 物镜拍摄，此时需要用脚本将20 倍图像压缩为10 倍图像后才能QC。
en: Tissue and cell morphology can be observed using 10X and 20X objective lenses, respectively. If the tissue and cell morphology under a 10X objective lens meet the requirements for downstream analysis, a 10X objective lens can be selected for imaging in the formal experiment (which can save time during the imaging step), and the images do not require conversion for QC. If higher image resolution is required, a 20X objective lens can be selected for imaging in the formal experiment, in which case a script must be used to compress the 20X images to 10X images before QC.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 提前将一个金属浴或其他同等功能仪器温度设置到37℃，PCR 仪程序为37℃∞（PCR 仪需要装载PCR 适配器（adaptor），无需热盖）；
en: 2) Pre-set a metal bath or an equivalent instrument to 37°C. Set the PCR instrument program to 37°C for ∞ (the PCR instrument must be equipped with a PCR adapter and does not require a heated lid).
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 3) 将配制好的1X 透化试剂工作液放在金属浴上回温1 min，将玻片放置在金属浴或PCR 适配器（adaptor）上，取100-200 μL 1X 透化试剂工作液滴加在组织上，直至液体完全覆盖到组织，此时立即开始计时，并观察组织形态，记录组织脱片时间，该时间即为透化时间上限，建议观察时间为30 min，若刚滴上1X 透化试剂工作液组织就开始脱片，则在做正式实验时不能进行透化步骤。
en: 3) Place the prepared 1X permeabilization reagent working solution on a metal bath to warm up for 1 min. Place the slide on the metal bath or PCR adapter. Pipette 100-200 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent working solution onto the tissue until the tissue is completely covered by the liquid. Start timing immediately and observe the tissue morphology. Record the time of tissue detachment, which is the upper limit for permeabilization time. The recommended observation time is 30 min. If the tissue begins to detach as soon as the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution is added, the permeabilization step cannot be performed in the formal experiment.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 预实验是保障正式实验成功率的关键步骤，强烈建议所有植物样本先完成预实验；染色方式选择可参考《植物测试参考样本目录》，若《植物测试参考样本目录》内已有该样本染色方式建议，仍需要进行预实验以观察组织脱片情况，但可省去拍照步骤。
en: The pre-experiment is a critical step to ensure the success rate of the formal experiment. It is strongly recommended that all plant samples first complete a pre-experiment. For the selection of the staining method, you may refer to the "Plant Test Reference Sample Catalog". If the "Plant Test Reference Sample Catalog" already contains suggestions for the staining method for the sample, a pre-experiment is still required to observe tissue detachment, but the photography step can be omitted.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 若组织块较大或含水量极高，可延长平衡时间至 60 min，但需避免过度复温（防止OCT 软化、组织水分融化，切割时因硬度不足、表面张力改变及温度梯度应力导致切片卷曲）。不可从 −80℃冰箱取出后立即切片，否则会因组织块温度极低，与切片机温度存在巨大温差，导致组织内部冰晶快速膨胀或重新结晶，加剧细胞结构破坏（尤其是含水量高的组织，冰晶损伤更为明显）；另外OCT 包埋剂在极低温下会变得过硬和易碎；

Do not proceed with sectioning immediately after removal from a −80°C freezer; otherwise, the extremely low temperature of the tissue block compared to the cryostat temperature will result in a significant temperature difference, causing rapid expansion or recrystallization of internal ice crystals and exacerbating the destruction of cellular structure (especially in tissues with high water content, where ice crystal damage is more pronounced); additionally, the OCT embedding medium becomes excessively hard and brittle at extremely low temperatures;

zh: 1) 粗修：去除多余 OCT，暴露组织表面。首先设置切片机参数，将切片厚度调至40 μm；然后缓慢摇动切片机手轮，从组织块顶部开始切削，每次进刀幅度均匀，观察到白色 OCT 逐渐被切除，直至暴露组织边缘（组织颜色通常与 OCT 不同）。
en: 1) Rough trimming: Remove excess OCT to expose the tissue surface. First, set the microtome parameters to a section thickness of 40 μm; then, slowly turn the microtome handwheel to begin cutting from the top of the tissue block, ensuring a uniform advance each time, and observe as the white OCT is gradually removed until the tissue edge is exposed (the tissue color is typically different from the OCT).
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 精修：平整组织表面，确保切片质量。首先调整切片机参数，将切片厚度调至10 μm，后缓慢摇动切片机手轮，缓慢进刀，每次切削 1~2 层，直至组织完全暴露。组织暴露后，继续切片，建议先用载玻片对修片切出的切片贴片，染色（适配植物的染料都可以）并进行观察（依据经验，可使用显微镜或体视镜），看是否已经到最佳切面；若尚未找到最佳切面，可继续切片，直至找到最佳的切面，切片并准备贴芯片。
en: 2) Fine trimming: Level the tissue surface to ensure section quality. First, adjust the microtome parameters to a section thickness of 10 μm, then slowly turn the microtome handwheel and advance slowly, cutting 1–2 layers at a time until the tissue is fully exposed. After the tissue is exposed, continue sectioning. It is recommended to first mount the sections from the trimming on microscope slides, stain them (any dye suitable for plants can be used), and observe them (based on experience, a microscope or stereomicroscope can be used) to check if the optimal sectioning plane has been reached; if the optimal sectioning plane has not yet been found, continue sectioning until it is reached, then section and prepare for chip mounting.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: ・	  每一种组织适合的切片温度都不一样，需要多尝试。对于植物样本，建议设置
en: - The optimal sectioning temperature varies for each type of tissue and requires experimentation. For plant samples, it is recommended to set
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 冻头温度比箱体温度低1℃，而具体的温度要根据环境温度进行调整。例如，在 STOmics R&D 实验室（温度24℃ 、湿度53% ）实际操作中，某植物根，设置冻头−18℃，箱体−17℃，沿着组织纹路切片，可切出较完整切片；某植物茎，设置冻头−20℃、箱体−19℃，可切出较完整切片；
en: the chuck temperature 1℃ lower than the chamber temperature, and the specific temperatures should be adjusted based on the ambient temperature. For example, in actual operations at the STOmics R&D laboratory (temperature 24℃, humidity 53%), for a certain plant root, the chuck was set to −18℃ and the chamber to −17℃, allowing relatively intact sections to be cut along the tissue grain; for a certain plant stem, the chuck was set to −20℃ and the chamber to −19℃, allowing relatively intact sections to be cut;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: ・	 对于易和OCT 分离的组织，切片无法改变，需改良包埋方法。

zh: 1)  连续切取组织切片（根据载体上的芯片数量进行调整），用细毛刷将冷冻切片轻轻展开铺平整，将冷 冻切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；

zh: 本说明书是使用DNBSEQ-T7RS 可视化试剂套装进行测序操作的作业指导书，内容包括制备DNA 纳米球（DNB），准备载片，可视化试剂盒组分、存储环境及使用方法，测序上机操作以及测序完成后的仪器维护等。
en: This manual provides operating instructions for sequencing procedures using the DNBSEQ-T7RS Visualization Kit. It covers the preparation of DNA nanoballs (DNB), preparation of slides, components, storage conditions, and usage of the visualization kit, instrument operation for sequencing, and post-sequencing instrument maintenance, etc.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本产品是用于测定时空文库序列的通用试剂盒，与基因测序仪（DNBSEQ-T7RS）配合使用，完成高通量测序并获取样本序列信息。本试剂套装仅供科研使用，不能用于临床诊断。
en: This product is a universal kit for sequencing spatial transcriptomic libraries. It is used in conjunction with the gene sequencer (DNBSEQ-T7RS) to perform high-throughput sequencing and obtain sample sequence information. This kit is for research use only and cannot be used for clinical diagnosis.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装使用联合探针锚定聚合技术（cPAS），通过将DNA 分子锚和荧光探针在DNA纳米球（DNB）上进行聚合，并利用高分辨率成像系统对光信号进行采集，光信号经过数字化处理后获得高质量高准确度的样本序列信息。
en: This reagent kit utilizes Combinatorial Probe Anchor Synthesis (cPAS) technology to polymerize DNA molecular anchors and fluorescent probes on DNA nanoballs (DNBs). Optical signals are collected using a high-resolution imaging system and then digitally processed to obtain high-quality, high-accuracy sample sequence information.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装适用于Stereo-seq 16 Barcode 建库试剂盒（货号：101KL160）构建的时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库、时空蛋白转录组Stereo-CITE V1.1 的转录组文库（CITE V1.1-cDNA）和抗体衍生标签（ADT）文库（CITE V1.1-ADT）。
en: This reagent set is applicable to Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 libraries, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE libraries, and transcriptome libraries (CITE V1.1-cDNA) and antibody-derived tag (ADT) libraries (CITE V1.1-ADT) for Stereo-seq protein transcriptomics Stereo-CITE V1.1, constructed using the Stereo-seq 16 Barcode Library Construction Kit (Cat. No.: 101KL160).
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 当测序正在进行时，控制软件自动调用basecall 软件分析，并输出测序数据到指定位置用于二次分析。
en: When sequencing is in progress, the control software automatically calls the basecalling software for analysis, and outputs the sequencing data to a specified location for secondary analysis.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 在测序过程中，测序总循环数是按照所选择的测序读长执行的。如PE25+62 测序，按照一链25 循环，二链62 循环（7-9 循环暗反应），共计84 循环执行，最后得到84 循环的序列数据。标签序列的10 循环需要额外进行计算。
en: During the sequencing process, the total number of sequencing cycles is performed according to the selected sequencing read length. For example, for PE25+62 sequencing, it is performed with 25 cycles for Read 1 and 62 cycles for Read 2 (including 7-9 cycles of dark reactions), totaling 84 cycles, and 84 cycles of sequence data are obtained at the end. The 10 cycles of the tag sequence require additional calculation.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂盒适用于时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库测序、时空蛋白转录组CITE V1.1-cDNA 文库和抗体衍生标签CITE V1.1-ADT 文库，文库为双链DNA。FFPE 文库插入片段范围在150 bp~1000 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。FF V1.3 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~600 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。CITE V1.1-cDNA 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~600 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。CITE V1.1-ADT 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~260 bp。
en: This kit is applicable to the Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 library, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE library sequencing, Stereo-seq CITE V1.1-cDNA library, and CITE V1.1-ADT library. These libraries are double-stranded DNA. The insert size range for the FFPE library is 150 bp to 1000 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the FF V1.3 library is 200 bp to 600 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the CITE V1.1-cDNA library is 200 bp to 600 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the CITE V1.1-ADT library is 200 bp to 260 bp.

zh: 根据具体应用所需的数据量，测序读长及测序Barcode 等信息决定可pooling 在一起上机的样本量。建议样本在DNB 制备完后，先定量DNB，再pooling DNB。由于每个Barcode 产出的数据量会有偏差，建议所需的总数据量不超过理论数据产量的90%。
en: Determine the number of samples that can be pooled together for sequencing based on the data volume required by the specific application, sequencing read length, and sequencing Barcode information. It is recommended to quantify the DNBs after DNB preparation is completed, and then pool the DNBs. Since the data volume produced by each Barcode may vary, it is recommended that the required total data volume does not exceed 90% of the theoretical data yield.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 对于有特殊测序深度要求的，可以适当增加或减少pooling的样本数量。
en: For projects with specific sequencing depth requirements, the number of pooled samples can be increased or decreased appropriately.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 例如：若总数量为3500 M，每个样本需要380 M 的数据量，建议每张载片最多同时测序 8 个样本。
en: For example: If the total capacity is 3500 M and each sample requires 380 M of data, it is recommended to sequence no more than 8 samples per flow cell simultaneously.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 每一个cycle 中，平衡的碱基组成对于好的测序质量来说非常重要，建议每个cycle 的A，C，G，T 四个碱基的相对含量均不低于12.5%。
en: In each cycle, balanced base composition is crucial for good sequencing quality. It is recommended that the relative content of each of the four bases (A, C, G, and T) in every cycle be no less than 12.5%.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: y 检查已经pooling 样本的Barcode，若某个碱基的相对含量在5~12.5% 间，可以风险上机。
en: Check the Barcode of the pooled samples. If the relative content of any base is between 5% and 12.5%, it can be sequenced at your own risk.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 若低于5%，则不建议上机，需重新规划pooling 方案。每个cycle，只有碱基含量相对较平衡时，才能达到最佳测序质量。
en: If it is lower than 5%, it is not recommended for sequencing, and the pooling scheme needs to be re-planned. Optimal sequencing quality can only be achieved when the base content is relatively balanced in each cycle.

zh: 本产品说明书是使用MGISEQ-2000RS 时空可视化试剂套装进行测序操作的作业指导书，内容包括DNA 纳米球（DNB）的制备及载片的准备，可视化试剂套装组分、存储环境及使用方法，测序上机操作以及测序完成后的仪器维护等。
en: This manual serves as an operation guide for performing sequencing with the MGISEQ-2000RS spatial visualization reagent kit, covering the preparation of DNA nanoballs (DNB) and slides, the components, storage conditions, and usage methods of the visualization reagent kit, sequencing loading operations, and post-sequencing instrument maintenance.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本产品是用于测定时空文库序列的通用试剂盒，与基因测序仪(MGISEQ-2000RS)配合使用，完成高通量测序并获取样本序列信息。本试剂套装仅供科研使用，不能用于临床诊断。
en: This product is a universal kit used for determining spatial library sequences, utilized in conjunction with a gene sequencer (MGISEQ-2000RS) to complete high-throughput sequencing and obtain sample sequence information. This reagent set is for research use only and cannot be used for clinical diagnosis.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装使用联合探针锚定聚合技术（cPAS），通过将DNA 分子锚和荧光探针在DNA纳米球（DNB）上进行聚合，并利用高分辨率成像系统对光信号进行采集，光信号经过数字化处理后获得高质量高准确度的样本序列信息。
en: This reagent set utilizes Combinatorial Probe-Anchor Synthesis (cPAS) technology, where DNA anchors and fluorescent probes are polymerized on DNA nanoballs (DNBs) and light signals are captured using a high-resolution imaging system to obtain high-quality and high-accuracy sample sequence information after digital processing.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装适用于Stereo-seq 16 Barcode 建库试剂盒（货号：101KL160）构建的时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库和抗体衍生标签（ADT）文库（ CITE V1.1-ADT）。
en: This reagent kit is suitable for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 libraries, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE libraries, and Antibody-Derived Tag (ADT) libraries (CITE V1.1-ADT) constructed with the Stereo-seq 16 Barcode Library Construction Kit (Cat. No.: 101KL160).
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 当测序正在进行时，控制软件自动调用basecall 软件分析，并输出测序数据到指定位置用于二次分析。
en: During sequencing, the control software automatically invokes the basecalling software for analysis and outputs the sequencing data to a designated location for secondary analysis.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 在测序过程中，测序循环数是按照所选择的测序读长执行的。例如，PE25+59 测序是按照一链25 循环，二链59 循环，共计84 循环执行，最后得到84 循环的序列数据。标签序列的10 循环数需要额外进行计算。
en: During the sequencing process, the number of sequencing cycles is executed according to the selected sequencing read length. For example, PE25+59 sequencing is executed with 25 cycles for Read 1 and 59 cycles for Read 2, totaling 84 cycles, resulting in 84 cycles of sequence data. The 10 cycles for the barcode sequence need to be calculated separately.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书
